result.note: Tests the partner and purpose of the HAL–Safran Aravalli helicopter engine deal, a concrete defence co-development agreement.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, HAL signed an agreement to co-develop a helicopter engine named 'Aravalli'. Consider the following statements:
items: HAL's partner in co-developing the engine is the American firm General Electric.
The engine is meant to power a domestic helicopter that will replace India's ageing Russian Mi-17 fleet.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because HAL's partner is France's Safran, not General Electric. Statement 2 is correct: the Aravalli engine will power a domestic replacement for the ageing Russian Mi-17 helicopters.
questions.source: HAL and France's Safran signed to co-develop a helicopter engine, the "Aravalli," to power a domestic replacement for India's ageing Russian Mi-17 fleet.
